title: the 33 names E406 could not resolve, resolved by the directory their literal is joined against

rule.population: every face E406 named from a blob reader (58): 33 unresolved + 25 compared as a control arm
rule.resolution: a name resolves when the literal at its site is joined against a repo root; a name that is only ever joined against a tempfile.mkdtemp() root is a selftest fixture
rule.temp_taint: a name carries a temp root when it is assigned from tempfile.mkdtemp / TemporaryDirectory / mkstemp, or from a join one of whose arguments carries one
rule.face_taint: a name carries the face when it is assigned from, loop-bound over, or built out of a literal that spells the basename
rule.verdict_order: temp_join > on_disk > repo join > repo-shaped literal > literal only
rule.stem_arm: a sibling with the same alphabetic stem is published and is NOT counted as resolution: a fixture name and the family it copies share a stem
rule.no_rewrite: no reader, leg or face is edited by this study
rule.self_exclusion: scripts/e421_strong_basis_resolution.py is removed from the candidate corpus: this study's own selftest spells the names it resolves

verdict: no unresolved name is a face the tree reads and lacks: 18 resolve to a file the reader itself spells, 0 exist under another directory than the census recorded, 1 are on disk, 9 are written only into a selftest temp dir, and 5 are named only by the census's own selftest
